issuer: the "Пътна полиция" (Traffic Police) units of the Sofia Directorate of Internal Affairs and the regional directorates of the Ministry of Interior

licence.name: свидетелство за управление на моторно превозно средство, категория B

note: Read 2026-10-31 in the Council of Ministers' Administrative Register (IISDA), the Ministry of Interior's service card for the first issue of a driving licence (service 448, provision 21851; mvr.bg answers this egress with a Cloudflare page, the register doesn't). It says the licence is issued by the Traffic Police units of the Sofia Directorate and the regional directorates of the Ministry, under the Road Traffic Act art. 159(1)(1) and the Bulgarian Identity Documents Act art. 51; that the minimum age for category B is eighteen; that the document is valid '10 години или 5 години'; and that the fee for a licence of a holder under 58 is 14.00 euro (5.62 euro from 58 to 70, free from 70; twice for a fast service, three times for an accelerated one; 14 euro for EU citizens and for foreigners too). The term of 10 years for B is my reading of the card's '10 or 5 years' together with the register's card for applications made abroad (service 2487, provision 38052), which gives '10 години – за лична карта и СУМПС'; the 5 years are the professional categories' (not stated on the card). The fee for holders over 58 isn't held by the form; the fee written is the one a first licence at 18 pays. No archive copy was needed.

sources.said: Звена "Пътна полиция" при Столичната дирекция на вътрешните работи и Областните дирекции на МВР ... 10 години или 5 години ... осемнадесет години - за управление на моторно превозно средство от категория В; ... 1. за свидетелство за управление на МПС на лице до 58-годишна възраст - 14.00 евро
